newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian National reopens Rocky Mountain rail line.
newsitem.headline: Canadian National reopens Rocky Mountain rail line.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co main rail line through the Fraser River Valley in the Rocky Mountain Range should reopen by 1100 MST/1800 GMT after it was shut by avalanches Dec 31 at 1800 MST/0100 GMT.
"We closed our line late New Year's Eve because of avalanches and we're reopening within the half hour," CN spokesman Jim Feeny told Reuters from Edmonton at 1030 MST.
CN's Yale and Boston Bar substations were blocked by snow slides after heavy snowfall this week.
The main line of CP Rail System, however, may remain shut until January 5.
"We're not projecting the line to reopen until Sunday," CP spokesman Steve Morris told Reuters from Calgary.
Grain loading on to ocean vessels remain unhindered by the rail blockage due to adequate terminal elevator stocks, Canadian Wheat Board spokeswoman Tracey Thompson said.
